verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires the RFQ document package to include and format the budget sheet; the unrelated submission dates are not included in the Event payload.
The client explicitly expands the document-layout obligation to apply the supplied tables to the final draft.
The client requires five proposal tables to be replaced with revised versions from the linked document, changing the approved table content used in the artifact.
The client changes the Payment and Milestone Schedule table to five rows per phase and explicitly permits either insertion or full-table replacement as the implementation method.
